name: shadcn/ui OIDC registry
notes: Registry index has 78 items: 2 blocks, 2 libs (policy, verify — server-side, not cataloged) and 74 components (claims, picker + 8 providers × 9 form-library variants).

Providers cataloged at family granularity (like Origin UI): each family ships plain, Zod, Valibot, React Hook Form (+Zod/+Valibot) and TanStack Form (+Zod/+Valibot) variants. Every install verified 200 at ui.shadcn.com/oidc/r/<name>.json.

components.name: OIDC Core
components.description: A starter policy form: GitHub Actions and Vercel behind a toggle picker, each form with its own submit. The file is yours — add providers, swap the picker, and wire onSubmit to your storage. The builder at the homepage generates this file for any provider combination.

components.name: OIDC Settings Page
components.description: A working settings page: app/settings/oidc renders the policy form, and a server action validates with validateOidcPolicy before saving. Wire the form's onSubmit to savePolicy and replace the console.log with your storage.

components.name: OIDC Claims Pieces
components.description: The shared pieces every provider form composes: the ClaimsList row editor for additional claims, the ClaimChip label marker, and the pure helpers that merge rows into a policy and read them back out.

components.name: OIDC Picker
components.description: Single-select provider picker that adapts to the count: a toggle row for up to three providers, a select beyond that, nothing for one.

components.name: GitHub Actions Provider
components.description: A self-contained form component that emits an OidcPolicy for a GitHub Actions caller: a repository (owner/repo or a pasted URL) and branch/tag/environment scoping with derived audience.

components.name: Vercel Provider
components.description: A self-contained form component that emits an OidcPolicy for a Vercel caller: team, project, and environment scoping with derived issuer, plus custom audiences via Vercel's OIDC token exchange.

components.name: GitLab CI Provider
components.description: A self-contained form component that emits an OidcPolicy for a GitLab CI caller: instance (gitlab.com or self-hosted), group and project, job-requested audience, and branch/tag/environment scoping.

components.name: Google Provider
components.description: A self-contained form component that emits an OidcPolicy for a Google service account caller: account email, optional rename-proof unique ID, and audience.

components.name: Bitbucket Provider
components.description: A self-contained form component that emits an OidcPolicy for a Bitbucket Pipelines caller: paste-in identity provider URL and audience from repository settings, plus repository UUID scoping. Note: the discovery document only exists after Pipelines OIDC is enabled and one pipeline has run.

components.name: AWS EKS Provider
components.description: A self-contained form component that emits an OidcPolicy for an AWS EKS workload: cluster OIDC issuer URL, Kubernetes namespace and service account, and audience. EKS is AWS's OIDC workload identity — plain EC2 and Lambda do not mint identity tokens.

components.name: Azure Provider
components.description: A self-contained form component that emits an OidcPolicy for a Microsoft Entra ID workload: tenant, the caller's object ID, optional client ID, and audience.

components.name: Custom OIDC Provider
components.description: The escape hatch for any OIDC issuer without a dedicated provider: issuer, audience, optional subject, and free-form optional claims, with a warning when a rule would trust an entire issuer. List it last in the providers array — it matches broadly.
